entities.summary: The Minobu Line  is a railway line in the Tōkai region of Japan operated by the Central Japan Railway Company. It runs between Fuji Station in Fuji, Shizuoka and Kōfu Station in Kōfu, Yamanashi, connecting the Tōkaidō Main Line to the Chūō Main Line.
